## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, change and scope. Link the relevant SPEC/PLAN/ISSUE records.

## Design and component boundaries

Native SDK/service capability used; rationale for any meaningful bespoke code. Note changed contracts, authority, modes, pins, policies and affected consumers, or state that none changed.

## Validation and evidence

Actual commands and outcomes, relevant negative cases, evaluation dimensions/metrics, and reviewed evidence/report links. Distinguish offline/fixture checks from live/durable qualification. State failed, blocked or unrun checks and remaining limits.

## Continuity

- [ ] Investigation changes preserve native unit tests at real application seams across languages/frameworks/CWEs; dependency doubles and independent validity evidence are explicit, and any integration requirement is justified by the property.
- [ ] Relevant tests/evaluations run and failures retained, or limitations explained.
- [ ] Design/qualification claims match actual evidence.
- [ ] Work records and current index updated; handoff added for substantial work.
- [ ] No private run/state artifacts or credentials included.
